newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Petrobras may get 1.7 bln-real bailout.
newsitem.headline: Petrobras may get 1.7 bln-real bailout.

text.p: Brazil's state oil monopoly Petrobras may receive a 1.7 billion-real government bailout to help cover 6.7 billion reais in losses from its subsidy of alcohol fuel, a local newspaper said.
Gazeta Mercantil said a decree authorizing the federal government payment is awaiting only the signature of Planning Minister Antonio Kandir, who has balked at the form of the payout.
The decree calls for payment of 650 million reais in stock, 200 million reais in cash and 850 million reais in 10-year National Treasury notes carrying 6.0 percent interest, the paper said.
The decree has already been signed by Finance Minister Pedro Malan and Mines and Energy Minister Raimundo Britto, the report said.
Petrobras reported a 6.7 billion loss in its alcohol fuel subsidy account at the end of the first half, it said.
